entry.title: 104 entries re-checked on 3 Oct 2026: 3 with new commits, 0 new releases, 1 re-grade (fly-cartpole, grade unchanged); FlyDoom (eganeganegan) returned HTTP 404 a third time and its link status is now 'gone' (record kept); 52 videos re-checked: all available, 0 removed; 3 entries added.

Does it actually run? Our headless-browser check of six fly-brain demos (Chromium 154, Linux, no GPU, 3 Oct 2026; not a play test): Fly Worker, FLY67 and flybrain.app ran (17.55, 33.28 and 12.72 MB); FlyLeno and Help the Fly Escape loaded, then froze in our no-GPU browser; fly-brain (Lulzx) stopped at our 1.6 GB memory limit. No demo computed on a server. New chart 'What your browser downloads to run a fly brain' and a results table.

Catalogue: six records gain the optional field browser_check, shown in the catalogue table, the filter tool and Ways to try; FLY67's download size corrected from 'about 100 MB' to 33.3 MB. link_status.status gains the value 'gone'. Both documented on For AI agents.

New project page for flyvis: numbers quoted from the full text, our ablation wording corrected (direction selectivity without synapse counts; only the T4/T5 preferred direction needs single-neuron detail), licences (code and pretrained models MIT), the 50 pretrained models' validation losses (median 5.300, range 5.137-5.678), the missing shuffled-wiring control and our CPU pre-check (no-go now).

Is it real?: a Last checked column on all 20 verdict rows (13 code unchanged since graded, 7 no code, 0 code changed); view counts updated (Gorilla Tag 724,625, still U); a driving compilation appears to show Flyhard (thumbnail-only match); FlyLeno row gains our browser-check line.

Controls ledger 2026-10-03-run7: 34 studies, 26 with a wiring null (helps 11, no difference 6, worse 2, mixed 6, not yet scored 1). New study ChessFly (no difference: 1680 vs 1675 Elo, weak). fly-cartpole re-read at a8c6257: no difference -> helps (499.9 vs 165.9 steps) but its linear map (499.6) and LQR (500) match it, so the baseline is not beaten. No scoring rule changed.
3 new entries: ChessFly (A, a negative result), flypoker (C) and neurafly (C); a FlyLeno fan page excluded.
Seventh research report: the browser check with its protocol, deviations and limits, the flyvis dossier, verdict freshness, the fly-cartpole re-grade, new entries, tracking and method.

100 entries re-checked on 2 Oct 2026: 6 with new commits, 0 new releases, 0 grade changes; FlyDoom (eganeganegan) returned HTTP 404 again and its record is kept; 51 videos re-checked: all available, 0 removed; 4 entries and 1 video added.

Our own pre-registered body test, Who does the walking?: the FlyGym fly walked 13.9 ± 0.58 mm in 1 s with the real brain (P9 stimulated), 14.15 mm with 3 scrambled brains that sent identical drives, 14.28 mm with a brainless constant drive and 13.96 mm with brainless random drives; the real brain added turning commands (DNa02); sugar sent no walking command (MN9 82 Hz) and the fly stood. The rate-to-drive mapping is ours and caps the drive. One stimulus, one model, one body, 1 s, open loop.

Controls ledger 2026-10-02-run6: 33 studies, 25 with a wiring null (helps 10, no difference 6, worse 2, mixed 6, not yet scored 1); new study byo-flygym-body (no difference, fair, strong; its 3 shuffles sent identical drives). No scoring rule changed; new display-only arm fields activity_ratio and activity_class; stale notes of our fair test fixed at the source; fly-cartpole updated to commit 077dcba (392.5 vs 390.3 steps, p = 0.48).

Gain check of our 1 Oct fair test: x2.5 matched shuffle 3 (10,138 spikes) but shuffles 4 and 5 fired 24,277 and 29,297, so the arm is not matched on 3 shuffles and tuned_equally stays false; MN9 stayed at 0 Hz in all six gain trials (0.37 to 2.12 times the real activity). Our row stays mixed, unfair and weak.

New verdict: "I put a fly's brain into Terraria. And tried to train it" (28,244 views on 2 Oct 2026), grade B: a checksummed MaleCNS v1.0 connectome with reward-modulated plasticity drives a Terraria body through hand-mapped senses and muscles; no control; the code predates the video.
Is it real? gains a Who does the walking? section with our body test as context for embodied claims (Eon, Gorilla Tag, FLY67); it changes no grade. Gorilla Tag re-checked at 623,504 views, still U.

4 new entries: Hidden attractor in the Shiu et al. model (A), Digital Fly in Terraria (B), How much of fly walking is written in the wiring? (B, provisional) and FlyGym + BANC v888 bridge (C, a derivative, not a lure).
1 new video in the gallery: the creator's upload of the Terraria fly (grade B). 52 videos; thumbnails unchanged.

Build your own: the deeper path Add a body is now tested (2 Oct 2026): brain tested, body tested (uv, CPython 3.12.11, flygym 2.1.0, MUJOCO_GL=disable, TMPDIR fix), mapping ours, with commands, pins, expected numbers and the full source.
How it works: a measured who-does-what diagram for a brain driving a body (stimulus, brain, our mapping, body controller).
Sixth research report: our body test, the gain check, the Terraria verdict, tracking, new entries, method and limits.
